milestone: Actual DuckDB sole selected pointer-arrow callee inspection
measurement: All-thread descendant RSS sampled every 100 ms; shared pages may count repeatedly and short peaks may be missed. Waited process RSS is separate.
scope: One actual sole direct-call target body of the returned pointer callee in the reproduced accessor tail. All parent/receiver/dependency inventories are selection-only; their type associations never populate the target type queue. Only the selected body seeds bounded shallow type facts. No recursive child body/layout closure, ownership, no-throw or translation admission.

bounds.NameQueryCaveat: Take bounds materialization; a paged public name query can still inspect underlying rows. Wall/RSS are controlled separately by the coordinator.

selectionBounds.selectorTypeAssociationsBoundedBy: Existing name/operation/parameter/entity/query/row bounds; locator associations only, no parent type queue.

relatedTypeScope: Target-only shallow type collection enabled immediately before the sole TraceRoot. Parent type references are separate stable locator associations, explicitly unexpanded and not target facts. The existing64-type bound applies only to the target signature/execution/local/body/one-hop declarations and explicit wrapper/pointee chains; no recursive record layouts or child bodies.

interpretation.body: RTL assignment of the actual direct get call result into a pointer local, followed by return of that local. The selected receiver expression is the retained cast of this, from the empty-base receiver view to the get formal pointer view. The call is LTR; no cast/source/base adjustment is reconstructed.
interpretation.identity: Selected receiver pointer, its execution-symbol top-level const wrapper, declared result pointer and local/returned pointer aliases remain distinct public identities. The one defined get body is not traversed by this mode.
interpretation.typeScope: Forty parent type associations are stable locators explicitly unexpanded and excluded from target type counts. The target queue was asserted empty before target signature/body collection; sixteen shallow type rows complete within the existing 64 bound. This is neither a cap increase nor completion of the earlier partial combined inventory.
interpretation.limits: Source noexcept=true is retained but no transitive no-throw/caller cleanup permission, general empty-base cast, pointer-result/body admission, ownership or linking follows.

limits: Only one actual target body is traced: 64 identities/256 occurrences/depth 32, 16 dependencies/64 target-only shallow types. Parent selectors retain separate identity/type association inventories, not execution schedules.
The earlier three-body report remains partial at 64 related types and retains exit 3. This additive mode has a different explicitly target-only type scope; it does not rewrite that evidence.
No recursive get body/layout expansion, source-name semantics, smart-pointer shortcuts, guard elimination or NoThrow/cache/caller-marker widening.
Translator, Runtime, providers and generated projects remain unchanged at 16a07ae6b; older SQLite/C++ evidence keeps original attribution.
Definition/link/exception contract of the unavailable guard helper and builtin expectation implementation remain separate obligations; full DuckDB execution is not accepted.
